turns.text: Hello, thanks for coming in. I'm Owen's English teacher.
Owen found out about his zero on his phone, in the middle of class, and nobody called me first. I have until 4:40. Who decided on the zero, and was Owen heard before it went in?
That's what I'm doing, Hale. You entered that mark, so tell me what it rests on.
If you escalate this, I'll make sure the academic integrity committee sees everything, including his two late assignments from September.

Go ahead, Hale, I'm going to the principal next anyway, and I'm writing down that you raised "two late assignments from September" to keep me quiet. Late homework has nothing to do with who wrote this essay. Now, what is the zero based on?
It isn't my call, Hale, it was yours, and you made it before anyone picked up a phone. If you have nothing to show me, I'm walking from here to the principal's office.
